dct_description_sm: Also shows adjacent coasts of Sumatra and the islands of Bengka and Belitin.

Also shows adjacent coasts of Sumatra and the islands of Bengka and Belitin. Depths shown by soundings. Hand drawn copy of printed original. "Published by Jones Horsburgh, Hydrographer to the Honble. E.I. Company, Jany. 1, 1819, according to Act of Parliament." Annotated in different hand to show the track of the "Brig Macedonian of Boston ... Nov. 1820." Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Acquisitions control no. 37-83B Vault
